import os

path='programs/task-add1012b.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and g[q[0]][q[1]] and q not in seen:
                            seen.add(q); st.append(q)
                comps.append(comp)
    # erase object whose marked cells form an unpaired diagonal pattern; choose smallest marked object
    candidates=[c for c in comps if sum(g[y][x]==9 for y,x in c)>=2]
    target=min(candidates,key=lambda c:(len(c),-sum(g[y][x]==9 for y,x in c)))
    for y,x in target:g[y][x]=0
    return g
'''
open(path,'w').write(code)
